evidence.Description: Optional schemaVersion defaults to 2020-08-15; 2021-03-18 adds platform.runtimeDone. Logs timeout minimum 25; omitted maxItems 10000.

Required schemaVersion accepts 2022-07-01, 2022-12-13, 2025-01-29. Request shape shares the published Logs destination/buffering shape; timeout minimum 25. Its maxItems default 1000 prose conflicts with native captures and telemetry-api.html.
Buffering table documents maxItems default 10000. 2025-01-29 supports Lambda Managed Instances and default functions.

Telemetry types [platform.runtimeDone] is rejected with HTTP400 Telemetry.ValidationError and Unrecognized enum variant during initial and reset initialization. Category subscriptions succeed across all five schema versions. The parser-advertised individual event vocabulary is not the accepted subscription filter enum.

Logs and Telemetry timeout25 accepted. Omitted maxItems delivers 10000-record batches with maxBytes1048576/timeoutMs30000. All five schema versions accepted; missing Logs schema accepted; missing Telemetry schema rejected. Native deserialization error enumerates individual platform event types as well as documented categories; that error alone does not establish individual-event subscription semantics.
